gatewayConnection.title: Connect coding clients
gatewayConnection.description: Use one stable public model alias in Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, and Pi. Change the model or API-key account behind that alias in Kun.
gatewayConnection.noAlias: Create and enable a routed model with an eligible API-key target first.
gatewayConnection.aliasHint: Keep this alias in each client. Changes to its targets apply to the next request without rewriting client configuration.
gatewayConnection.notApplied: disabled or waiting for configuration sync
gatewayConnection.managedHint: Open Agent settings to install, choose a gateway provider/model, and explicitly check and enable that exact profile. Kun generates isolated per-session configuration and a scoped token when the agent runs.
gatewayConnection.evidenceHint: Native login, an API key being configured, protocol readiness, upstream authentication, and a successful inference are different checks. A readiness check does not prove API-key authentication or quota.
gatewayConnection.manualHint: Review a redacted standalone setup for an isolated launch profile. Use Apply below for Kun-owned files, or copy the configuration for manual setup. A public client key permits billable requests through your enabled public routes.
gatewayConnection.clientKeysHint: Give each client its own key so its access can be revoked independently. Keys are copied once by the desktop app and are never included in this preview.
gatewayConnection.desktopKeys: Create and copy client keys in the Kun desktop app.
gatewayConnection.keyCopied: Key copied once. Store it securely before copying another snippet; a lost key must be replaced.
gatewayConnection.confirmRevoke: Revoke the key for {{name}}? New requests using it will be rejected.
gatewayConnection.revokeFailed: The client key could not be revoked.
gatewayConnection.stepKey: Create a separate client key above. Set KUN_GATEWAY_API_KEY securely in the shell that will launch the client; do not commit the key.
gatewayConnection.stepFile: Save the reviewed configuration to {{path}} in your chosen directory. Create parent directories first; back up any existing file and compare it before replacing it.
gatewayConnection.stepEnvironment: Review the session-only environment below. Existing native login variables are cleared for this launch.
gatewayConnection.stepLaunch: Keep Kun open with the local API enabled. Run the launch command from the directory containing .kun-gateway (POSIX shell; on Windows set the same environment variables before launch).
gatewayConnection.stepVerify: Use the authenticated GET /models example in API docs first. This verifies the local key only. Send a model request only when ready to consume your provider quota.
gatewayConnection.copyFailed: Copy failed; select and copy the preview manually.
gatewayConnection.restoreHint: To undo, stop using this launch profile and revoke its client key. If you manually replaced a file, restore your backup. OpenCode can merge other global/project settings; check its resolved configuration before use.
gatewayConnection.boundaries: Cursor stays on its supported native provider path. Gemini CLI is retired as a harness. WorkBuddy is not a supported integration. Subscription/OAuth credentials are never exported through the public gateway.
gatewayConnection.messagesDesc: Anthropic Messages-compatible requests use the same public route aliases and independent local gateway keys.
gatewayConnection.messagesLimits: Only supported message and tool content is accepted; unsupported upstream features are rejected. A model request may consume provider quota.
gatewayConnection.authRequired: Authentication is required, including GET /models. A model list verifies local gateway access, not upstream provider authentication.
gatewayConnection.profileHint: Choose a folder, review the exact file, then apply. Kun only replaces profiles it generated and refuses outside edits or links. The previous generated configuration is backed up; Restore returns to it, or removes the first generated profile. Your native client home stays untouched. Keep .kun-gateway out of version control: clients may save session history or account state there.
gatewayConnection.profileApplied: Profile saved. Launch the client yourself with the command below; no inference was run.
gatewayConnection.profileRestored: Previous profile restored. For a newly created profile, its generated files were removed.
gatewayConnection.claudeCompatibility: Claude Code uses a session-only environment. The compatibility launch disables thinking and automatic effort because signed/adaptive reasoning is not supported by this gateway; other model capabilities still depend on the selected route.
gatewayConnection.usageCostHint: Provider-reported tokens only. Cost is unverified and is not a reconciled provider bill.
gatewayConnection.usageSessionHint: An optional x-kun-gateway-session-id header correlates requests inside this client. It is stored as an opaque client-bound hash, not a Kun conversation ID.
gatewayConnection.noUsage: No recorded model requests for this client yet.
gatewayConnection.skippedTargets: {{count}} configured targets are skipped by the public gateway
